## Quality & Test Checklist
- [ ] Automated Unit Tests added or updated in `tests/`
- [ ] All backend unit & API tests pass (`npm run test:unit && npm run test:api`)
- [ ] Backend test coverage >= 55% verified (`npm run test:cov`)
- [ ] Frontend component tests pass (`npm run test:frontend`)
- [ ] Frontend builds cleanly with zero errors (`npm run build`)
- [ ] No hardcoded secrets or credentials introduced
- [ ] If changing schemas, backward compatibility fallback verified
- [ ] Biometric quality gates respected (FAR <= 1%, Spoof <= 5%)
